title: 贝尔实验室与伯克利的最初接触
issue: 麦库西克《伯克利 UNIX 二十年》载：1973 年 11 月汤普森与里奇在普渡大学 SOSP 宣读首篇 UNIX 论文，伯克利的法布里与会后‘immediately became interested in obtaining a copy of the system’，1974 年 1 月 Version 4 磁带送达装机——1973 年论文引来取件意向属实。

title: 远程调试启动的协作惯例
issue: 同文载：伯克利仅有 300 波特声耦合调制解调器，‘Thompson would call Standiford in the machine room and have him insert the phone into the modem; in this way Thompson was able to remotely debug crash dumps’——隔电话线远程调试崩溃转储属实。

title: 三系联合购机的权宜安排
issue: 同文载：‘The Computer Science Department at Berkeley, together with the Mathematics Department and the Statistics Department, were able to jointly purchase a PDP-11/45’——计算机、数学、统计三系联合购机属实。

title: DARPA 合同与 CSRG 的设立
issue: 同文载：‘Bob Fabry was able to get an 18-month contract with DARPA beginning in April 1980’并据此‘sets up an organization which was christened the Computer Systems Research Group’——1980 年 18 个月合同与法布里组建命名 CSRG 逐点吻合。

title: 行政与开发的初次分工
issue: 同文载：法布里‘hired Laura Tong to handle the project administration’，软件开发则由尚在攻读博士的乔伊接手——行政与发行先由专人承担、开发归在读研究生，分工先于成文制度，吻合。

title: 家族树作为分离与聚合的判据
issue: 官方家族树即 FreeBSD src/share/misc/bsd-family-tree，实测取回：全树把 1BSD 至 4.4BSD-Lite2 及各当代 BSD 派生按时序列成一张图，树尾自注‘Time tolerance +/- 6 months’——分支与时序同图可逐条核对，吻合。

title: 共同上游与派生分支的界定
issue: 体例题：以共同上游界定派生次序属方法论表述，无独立外部事实断言；经目录核查并与家族树结构对照（32V、4.3BSD NET/2 等共同上游节点组织各支），判形态。

title: 分叉时点的可考证据
issue: 体例题：分叉时点须落到具体版本与月份属方法论准则；家族树本身即以版本加年月标注时点并自注时间容差，判形态。

title: 共用框架的取用通道
issue: 体例题：以共用框架整合第三方软件属编目与叙事分层方法论表述，无外部事实断言；离线目录核查通过，判形态。

title: 模型适用范围的自我限定
issue: 体例题：限定模型适用范围、不把假设当作已发生历史，属方法论自我限定，无外部事实断言，判形态。

title: DARPA 统一操作系统层的选择
issue: 麦库西克载：DARPA 视研究软件移植为换机最大成本、各站因硬件与操作系统各异无法共享，遂‘decided that the best solution was to unify at the operating systems level’，并因‘its proven portability’选定 UNIX——逐点吻合。

title: 指导委员会的双年议事
issue: 同文载：指导委员会‘met twice a year between April 1981 and June 1983’，成员含伯克利、BBN、贝尔实验室等方——1981 至 1983 年每年集会两次，吻合。

title: 源码共享的同行惯例
issue: 同文载：汤普森远程调试是‘the first example of the cooperation that sprang up between Berkeley and Bell Labs’，实验室研究者乐于共享成果；古维茨向伯克利释出早期 TCP/IP 实现亦属此类——共享惯例先于合同，吻合。

title: 合同续签与经费量级
issue: 同文载：第二期合同为‘a new two-year contract was granted to Berkeley with funding almost five times that of the original’——约为首期五倍（原文将近五倍），吻合。

title: 学术网络中的工具扩散
issue: 同文载：rcp、rsh、rlogin、rwho 等‘intended to be temporary tools’，4.1a 首次发行‘for local use……though bootleg copies of the system proliferated as sites grew impatient’——工具为自用而写、随 4.1a 流入站点、扩散由使用需求带动，吻合。

title: Multics 退场留下的空位
issue: 里奇《UNIX 分时系统的演变》载：‘the slow, though clearly inevitable, withdrawal of the Labs from the Multics project’，且当时‘even the time-sharing service that would later be offered under GE's operating system did not exist’——实验室退出 Multics 后分时服务缺口属实。

title: PDP-7 上的一次副产物
issue: 同文载：汤普森很快找到‘a little-used PDP-7 computer with an excellent display processor; the whole system was used as a Graphic-II terminal’，随后在此机上实现文件系统并长出系统——闲置小型机因显示处理器被取用、开发起点由此确定，吻合。

title: 联合体构想中的集体计算
issue: 同文当事人自述：‘What we wanted to preserve was not just a good environment in which to do programming, but a system around which a fellowship could form’——与题面逐点相合。

title: 被拒的机型提案与转向
issue: 同文载：1969 年间力主购置中型机（PDP-10 与 Sigma 7），‘our proposals were never clearly and finally turned down, but yet were certainly never accepted’，最终方案‘The proposal was rejected’——屡次未获批复属实；后落实于手头 PDP-7。

title: 系统自举与命名的先后
issue: 同文载：‘once an assembler was completed the system was able to support itself’，而命名迟至 1970 年间由克尼汉提出（原文：‘Brian Kernighan suggested the name “Unix”’）——自举在先、命名在后，吻合。

title: 4.2BSD 与网络协议的整合
issue: 麦库西克载：BBN 的古维茨向伯克利释出早期 TCP/IP 实现，乔伊整合进系统并调优，随后与莱夫勒‘redesigned the internal structuring of the software, refining the interfaces so that multiple network protocols could be used simultaneously’——BBN 早期版本入内核、乔伊按多协议需求重排接口，吻合。

title: 发行份数与装机规模
issue: 同文载（4BSD 条目）：‘During its nine-month lifetime, nearly 150 copies were shipped’，许可‘on a per-institution basis rather than a per machine basis; thus the distribution ran on about 500 machines’——数字逐项吻合；但此组数字属 1980 年 10 月的 4BSD 而非 4.2BSD（后者为 18 个月逾千份 site license），题面未系名于 4.2BSD 故判确证，成文时须明标 4BSD 归属。

title: 4.3BSD 的代码来源之争
issue: 同文载：BBN 向 DARPA 主张伯克利应换用其 TCP/IP 实现；DARPA 交巴利斯蒂克研究所的缪斯作双方认可的独立第三方测评，结论伯克利代码更高效且通过全部测试而 BBN 代码在压力下崩溃，‘The final decision by DARPA was that 4.3BSD would stick with the Berkeley code base’——吻合。

title: Net/2 的清理与六文件缺口
issue: 同文载：‘Karels, Bostic, and I spent the next several months going over the entire distribution, file by file’，清毕发现‘there were only six remaining kernel files that were still contaminated’，且‘we decided instead to release just what we had’——逐文件清理、余六文件受染、只发行已清部分，逐点吻合。

title: 厂商系统的网络子系统继承
issue: 同文载：‘Although most of the vendors had started the switch back to System V, large parts of 4.3BSD were carried over into their systems, particularly the networking subsystem’——转向 System V 与整段继承同时发生，吻合。

title: 源码随发行物一并交付
issue: 同文载：4.3BSD-Tahoe 及以前‘all BSD systems were never released by Berkeley in a binary-only format; the distributions always contained the complete source’，用户因而‘actively worked to fix bugs, improve performance and functionality’——含源交付与自行修错，吻合。

title: Networking Release 1 的许可条款
issue: 同文载：网络代码与工具于 1989 年 6 月以 Networking Release 1 发行，为‘the first freely-redistributable code from Berkeley’，许可‘with no accounting or royalties to Berkeley’，条件仅保留版权声明与文档致谢——不取版税、只要求保留声明致谢，吻合。

title: 磁带费与自由转取的安排
issue: 同文载：‘Berkeley charged a $1,000 fee to get a tape, anyone was free to get a copy from anyone who already had received it’——千元磁带费与自由转取属实；许可本身零版税，收费非许可限制。另注麦库西克言‘their fees helped fund further development’，成文时‘工本’表述宜放宽为发行成本与后续开发经费、非许可对价。

title: 版权声明保留的分发条件
issue: 同文载：许可条件为‘the copyright notices in the source file be left intact’并在文档中注明出处，条件落在声明而非使用方式；免责条款见 4.4BSD 版权全文（FreeBSD 版权页所载‘AS IS……DISCLAIMED’条），CSRG 4.4BSD-Lite 发行函重申 due credit 与版权声明为再分发前提，吻合。

title: 广告致谢条款的后续删除
issue: 加州大学技术转让办公室主任霍斯金斯 1999 年 7 月 22 日致全体 BSD 被许可方函：‘Effective immediately, licensees and distributors are no longer required to include the acknowledgement within advertising materials’，第三条款‘hereby deleted in its entirety’——1999 年明令取消广告致谢属实（该函适用于 UC 版权的 BSD 文件，FreeBSD 版权页全文转载）。

title: BSD UNIX 名称的混用年代
issue: 麦库西克载：伯克利原拟 5BSD，AT&T 以客户会与 System V 混淆为由反对而改 4.x 编号；后 USL 又函令 BSDI 停以 Unix 名义宣传——1980 年代 BSD UNIX 名称的产权与商标边界尚未划定，多方印证，吻合。

title: 厂商转向 System V 的时点
issue: 同文载：多数厂商已开始回流 System V，而‘large parts of 4.3BSD were carried over into their systems, particularly the networking subsystem’，且后续 BSD 成果仍持续进入 System V——转向与继承并行、非一刀切，吻合。

title: CSRG 作为磁带发行机构
issue: 与一手相悖：麦库西克明载首次发行系乔伊 1977 年初个人组装（原文：‘Early in 1977, Joy put together the “Berkeley Software Distribution”’，并寄出约三十份），CSRG 系 1980 年 DARPA 合同下才命名设立；NetBSD 官网所载家族树时间线亦标 1BSD 为 1977 年末。‘自 1976 年起 CSRG 以磁带为发行单位’年份早于发行、机构当时尚不存在，两头皆误。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 伯克利磁带发行先于 CSRG 建制

title: 发行规模的逐年记录
issue: 同文载：4.1BSD‘Over its two-year lifetime about 400 distributions were shipped’——两年约四百份，吻合。

title: 伯克利声望的外溢效应
issue: 同文载：‘With the increasingly wide distribution and visibility of Berkeley Unix, several critics began to emerge’，卡什坦基准测试批评引来乔伊数周内写就反驳论文——声望与质疑同增，吻合。

title: 经费枯竭与关闭风险
issue: FreeBSD《解释 BSD》载：‘By 1990, the CSRG's funding was running out, and it faced closure’；麦库西克亦载其后靠 4.4BSD 发行所得‘used to fund a part-time effort’维持整理——1990 年前后资助将尽、面临关闭，两源相合。

title: Net/2 缺件的技术底账
issue: 《解释 BSD》载：‘Net/2 was not a complete operating system: about 20% of the kernel code was missing’；约利茨《移植 UNIX 到 386》自述取‘the unencumbered but incomplete NET/2 kernel and finished the missing pieces’——约两成内核缺口、发行物非完整系统，两源相合。

title: 许可依赖构成的天花板
issue: 麦库西克载：‘Up through the release of 4.3BSD-Tahoe, all recipients of BSD had to first get an AT&T source license’——磁带含 AT&T 代码即须先取得源码许可，吻合。

title: 少数人承担的清理工程量
issue: 同文载：清理系卡雷尔斯、博斯蒂克与其本人三人‘going over the entire distribution, file by file’、历时数月——工程量由少数核心成员承担，吻合（工具层重写另有网络众包，题面指清理判读层面成立）。

title: 解散决定与移交方式
issue: 同文载：末批修改以 4.4BSD-Lite Release 2 于 1995 年 6 月发行，‘Following the release of 4.4BSD-Lite Release 2, the CSRG was disbanded’，移交取向即‘several groups with different charters ensures that many different approaches will be tried’——逐点吻合；另注 CSRG 1994 年 3 月发行函已自称‘has shut down (other than a brief reunion)’，建制先停与 Lite2 后正式解散可并存。

title: BSDI 广告与电话号的争执
issue: 麦库西克载：BSDI 开卖并登 1-800-ITS-Unix 广告后即收 USL 函，‘demanded that they stop promoting their product as Unix and in particular that they stop using the deceptive phone number’——争执先于诉讼发生，吻合。

title: USL 诉状的诉因范围
issue: 同文载：‘The suit alleged that the BSDI product contained proprietary USL code and trade secrets. USL sought to get an injunction to halt BSDI's sales’——诉因落在专有代码与商业秘密两点、救济请求指向销售禁令，逐点吻合。

title: 禁令驳回的四十页意见
issue: 同文载：1992 年 12 月新泽西联邦地区法官德贝瓦瓦斯听取禁令辩论后‘decided to take it under advisement’，约六周后发出‘a forty-page opinion in which he denied the injunction and threw out all but two of the complaints’——留待考虑、四十页意见、仅余两项指控，逐点吻合。

title: 加州反诉的管辖选择
issue: 同文载：加大次周一即赶入加州州法院反诉，‘By filing first in California, the University had established the locale of any further state court action’——抢先在加州起诉、锁死州法院诉讼地，吻合。

title: Novell 收购与和解达成
issue: 同文载：州法院立案后不久 Novell 自 AT&T 买下 USL，诺尔达公开声明宁在市场竞争不在法院缠讼，1994 年 1 月达成和解；BSDI 公告（1994-02-06）载和解日为 2 月 4 日——转手、新东家偏好竞争、和解推进，吻合。

title: 三文件移出与版权标注
issue: 麦库西克载：‘three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2’且大学同意‘add USL copyrights to about 70 files’；UCB-USL 联合新闻稿亦载‘requires that certain files in 4.4 BSD-Lite include a USL copyright notice’——三件移出、约七十件加注，两源相合。

title: 4.4BSD-Lite 的再许可
issue: 麦库西克载：4.4BSD-Lite 于 1994 年 6 月发行，条款‘identical to those used for the Networking releases’；CSRG 发行函载‘may be freely redistributed without fee’且‘requires no previous license from AT&T, Novell/USL, or The Regents of the University of California’——清源版本沿用网络发行条款、法律状态转为可分发，吻合。

title: 重启代码库的合并代价
issue: 麦库西克载：‘BSDI, NetBSD, and FreeBSD, had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources’且‘this reintegration caused a short-term delay’；FreeBSD 手册载转基至 1994 年 11 月方成、12 月发行 2.0——三支重启代码库、短期进度整体推迟，吻合。

title: 名称权随代码清源而失去
issue: 部分可证：USL 诉讼前即函令 BSDI 停以 Unix 名义宣传（麦库西克），4.4BSD-Lite 清源后无需 AT&T、Novell/USL 或加大任何许可（CSRG 发行函）；但‘最后一点 AT&T 代码被清除后 BSD 失去 UNIX 名称使用权’作为和解条款的直接文本未获一手——BSDI 和解公告明言‘All other terms of the settlement are confidential’，UCB-USL 联合新闻稿亦无名称条款；已查麦库西克、两份官方新闻稿、CSRG 发行函、NetBSD 1.0 公告均无明文，判存疑。建议成文改作可证表述（名称使用权随源码许可脱钩）或补和解协议原文。

title: 和解条款的溯及效力
issue: 麦库西克载：‘The lawsuit settlement also stipulated that USL would not sue any organization using 4.4BSD-Lite as the base for their system’——USL 不再起诉以 Lite 为基的项目、效力向后覆盖派生方，吻合。

title: 386BSD 的匿名取用与追随
issue: 麦库西克载：约利茨‘simply put it up for anonymous FTP and let anyone who wanted it download it for free. Within weeks he had a huge following’，且因全职在身无法应对‘the flood of incoming bug fixes and enhancements’——匿名 FTP 任人取用、数周聚集大批用户、维护难以为继，逐点吻合。

title: NetBSD 的四位发起人
issue: NetBSD 官网历史页载：‘The NetBSD project was founded by Chris Demetriou, Theo de Raadt, Adam Glass and Charles M. Hannum’，并载‘Frustration with the quality of patches in the wild and the inability to get patches included in 386BSD led to the founding of the NetBSD project in 1993’——1993 年四位具名发起人，逐点吻合。

title: FreeBSD 补丁包积弊与撤回
issue: FreeBSD 手册载：项目起于‘the Unofficial 386BSDPatchkit's last 3 coordinators’的清理快照计划，因‘Bill Jolitz suddenly decided to withdraw his sanction from the project’而中断，三人遂另立 FreeBSD（名称由格林曼所拟）——补丁包积弊、作者撤回认可、整理者转为独立项目，逐点吻合。

title: OpenBSD 的人事驱逐与分叉
issue: 两份一手：NetBSD core 成员格拉斯 1994 年 12 月 23 日致 netbsd-users：原文‘On December 20, Theo de Raadt was asked to resign from the NetBSD Project by the remaining members of “core”’；德拉特自存档页：‘December 15 (when they removed all my NetBSD access)’且‘I struggled for 7 months to get access to the CVS tree back’——1994 年末被要求辞职并失去仓库权限、分叉随之发生（OpenBSD 成型于 1995 年 10 月），吻合。

title: 两次分立的性质差别
issue: 综合两已证事实：NetBSD 官网载 1993 年由四人共同发起（协调人集体另立）；theos.com 自存档载德拉特与 NetBSD core 五人（康克林、德米特里欧、格拉斯、汉纳姆、克兰肯堡）的往来及失权经过，OpenBSD 分叉系其个人对组织——1993 年集体另立、1995 年个人对决组织的对比成立。

title: 反事实推演的设问条件
issue: 体例题：反事实设问须先交代被改动项，属方法论准则，无外部事实断言；离线目录核查通过，判形态。

title: 法律冻结的时段与后果
issue: FreeBSD 手册载：‘This included FreeBSD, and the project was given until the end of July 1994 to stop shipping its own Net/2 based product’；麦库西克亦载各支须转以 4.4BSD-Lite 为基——1994 年 7 月末换基期限，两源相合。

title: 和解时点的外部变量
issue: 麦库西克载：加州立案后不久 Novell 接手 USL，诺尔达声明宁在市场竞争，1993 年夏和谈启动、1994 年 1 月达成——诉讼收束与外部产权变动相随，后者为时点关键变量，吻合。

title: 若无诉讼的替代路径
issue: 同文载：‘Within six months of the release, Bill Jolitz had written replacements for the six missing files’——六文件缺口半年内补写属实；反事实推断（无诉讼则完整系统时点前移）以此为锚，属合理设问。

title: 反事实论证的边界
issue: 体例题：反事实的史学分析作用与其不能替代实存证据的边界，属方法论表述，无外部事实断言；离线目录核查通过，判形态。

title: Ports 树的维护分工
issue: 官方 administration 页列明三团队分工：portmgr 负责保障 Ports 树“functional, stable, up-to-date and full-featured”；pkgmgr 之职为“assure the ports tree remains functional…maintain the automated package building cluster, and make the resulting packages available”；srcmgr“responsible for issues relating to the base system”。“打包与基础系统维护分属不同职责”成立；“第三方软件由 pkgmgr 团队统筹”按包管理口径成立，Ports 树社区统筹属 portmgr，正文引用宜注明两团队分层。

title: 发行分支与冻结纪律
issue: releng 官方文：“The code freeze marks the point in time where all commits to the branch require explicit approval from the FreeBSD Release Engineering Team”（提交须带 “Approved by: re (login)”），“Approximately two months before the start of the release cycle, the FreeBSD Release Engineering Team decides on a schedule for the release”——冻结期改动须批准、节奏由工程团队按期设定，两句均中；administration 页亦列 re 职责含 announcing code freezes 与 setting and publishing release schedules。

title: Core Team 的集体决策
issue: administration 页：“The FreeBSD Core Team constitutes the project's ‘Board of Directors’, responsible for deciding the project's overall goals and direction”；手册：“The primary task of the core team is to make sure the project, as a whole, is in good shape and is heading in the right directions”。administration 页 doceng／portmgr／srcmgr／re／secteam 各团队均附 charter 链接，唯 Core Team 无章程链接——“职权范围未完全成文”与官方页面口径相合。

title: 安装器与 CD-ROM 发行
issue: 手册史节：“Walnut Creek CDROM not only supported the idea of distributing FreeBSD on CD but also went so far as to provide the project with a machine to work on and a fast Internet connection”“The first CD-ROM (and general net-wide) distribution was FreeBSD 1.0, released in December of 1993”；sysinstall(8) 手册页（FreeBSD 9.3）：“The sysinstall utility is used for installing and configuring FreeBSD systems. It is the first utility invoked by the FreeBSD installation boot floppy”，且支持脚本化安装；10.0R 发行注载明 sysinstall 后由 bsdinstall(8) 取代——安装器与 CD-ROM 发行两条皆有官方一手。

title: 回馈范围的自决权
issue: about 页：“And the Berkeley open source license lets them decide how many of their local changes they want to contribute back.”——回馈多寡为使用者自主选择，逐字命中。

title: port 作为支持单位的口径
issue: ports 页：“NetBSD calls a supported architecture a port.”；支持承诺以 port 为单位登记（三级分层表逐 port 记录 CPU、机型与 Latest Release）。

title: 三级分层与支持承诺
issue: ports 页：“Ports are classified into three tiers based on the current importance of the architecture and the level of community activity”“the tiers can be viewed to represent ports that NetBSD will support, ports that NetBSD does its best to support, and ports which may be desupported soon”——三级即三种公开的支持强度承诺，层级由 core 决定（现行 Tier I 8 个、Tier II 49 个、Tier III 1 个）。

title: 逐平台清单的积累
issue: ports 页逐平台清点（各 port 注明 CPU 与机型），并称“The NetBSD Ports History page details the inclusion date for each port”——清单可视、可累积、带收录日期，便于对外对照。

title: 口号作为身份宣言
issue: portability 页：“NetBSD's slogan is “Of course it runs NetBSD”, and with good cause.”，紧接“At the time of writing NetBSD provides formal releases for 53 architectures”——口号与可移植性身份直接绑定，官方原文。

title: 架构独立的首位目标
issue: history 页：“NetBSD's original focus was quality and architecture independence.”；about 页目标清单以“provides a well designed, stable, and fast BSD system”与“provides a portable system, which runs on many hardware platforms”居首；portability 页 MD／MI 分层使“the code is written once, and used many times”——质量与架构独立为首要自述目标，平台数量为其结果。

title: 逐文件审计的方法定位
issue: security 页 Audit Process：“The process we follow to increase security is simply a comprehensive file-by-file analysis of every critical software component.”；proactive 节：“Another facet of our security auditing process is its proactiveness…We fix the bug, and we move on to find other bugs to fix.”——逐个关键组件通读排查、先于事后修补，逐字命中。

title: 六到十二人的审计小组
issue: security 页：“Our security auditing team typically has between six and twelve members who continue to search for and fix new security holes. We have been auditing since the summer of 1996.”——六至十二人为官方原文（typically 口径）。

title: 默认安全配置的取向
issue: security 页 Secure by Default：“we ship the operating system in a Secure by Default mode. All non-essential services are disabled.”，并对照“This is in stark contrast to the increasing number of systems that ship with NFS, mountd, web servers, and various other services enabled by default”——默认关闭即安全策略，与题面相合。

title: 加拿大发行地的出口便利
issue: goals 页：“OpenBSD is developed and released from Canada and due to Canadian law it is legal to export crypto to the world”；security 页：“since the OpenBSD project is based in Canada, it is possible for us to integrate cryptography”——两处官方陈述互证。

title: 半年发行节奏的确定
issue: goals 页目标清单明列：“Make a release approximately every six months.”——半年一版写入官方目标，逐字命中。

title: 自 FreeBSD 4.8 分叉的起点
issue: history 页：“DragonFly BSD was forked from FreeBSD 4.8 in June of 2003, by Matthew Dillon.”；features 页：“…the original FreeBSD-4.8 fork”；Dillon 2003 年 7 月 16 日致 freebsd-hackers 的 “Announcing DragonFly BSD!” 为分叉当时一手记录。

title: 令牌作为内核同步基础
issue: history 页：“One of the fundamental synchronization concepts that DragonFly uses throughout the kernel, the token, lends itself directly to ease of maintenance and understandability of the kernel.”——令牌为内核基本同步概念、利于维护与理解，逐字命中。

title: 单系统映像的最初目标
issue: history 页：“The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.”——初始目标即内核原生聚类（单系统映像），官方原文。

title: HAMMER 的历史保留设计
issue: history 页：“HAMMER saw its first light of day in July 2008 with the DragonFly 2.0 release. This filesystem has been designed to solve numerous issues…such as fine-grained history retention (snapshots), instant crash recovery, and near real-time mirroring.”——细粒度历史保留、快速恢复、2008 年随 2.0 面世，逐字命中。

title: 虚拟内核的开发用途
issue: 主页：“Virtual kernels provide the ability to run a full-blown kernel as a user process for the purpose of managing resources or for accelerated kernel development and debugging.”——完整内核作为用户进程运行、服务于调试与资源管理，官方明言；features 页 VKERNEL 节同义。

title: APSL 条款的开放边界
issue: Apple 官方 APSL 页载“APPLE PUBLIC SOURCE LICENSE Version 2.0 - August 6, 2003”，第 2 条逐款划定未修改代码、修改代码与外部部署的许可边界；SPDX 收录同日（“This license was released: 6 August 2003”）——版本与日期可查，开放范围由条款逐条划出。

title: Darwin 源码的按期发布
issue: opensource.apple.com：“You can access the source code for our operating systems and developer tools by downloading releases or browsing Git repositories.”——源码以发行包与仓库两种方式放出，官方自述。

title: 开放核心与产品外壳的分层
issue: opensource.apple.com 自述：“Open source software is at the heart of Apple platforms and developer tools.”——开源居平台与开发工具核心位置；该页仅列项目与获取方式，未涉产品层许可安排。

title: Rhapsody 的 NetBSD 基座
issue: NetBSD 官方 history 页：“NetBSD has also been used as the basis of other derivatives, including Apple's Rhapsody and Force 10's FTOS”——Rhapsody 为 NetBSD 系衍生；Apple 开发者档案文档：“Most libraries and utilities are from FreeBSD…, but some are derived from NetBSD”——两独立官方源互证，早期系统以 NetBSD 为基座之一成立。

title: 许可模板的个案差异
issue: Apple APSL 页官方明言：“The following license text is only a template. To determine the specific license terms that apply to a project, look at the project source code license headers and the actual license included with the project.”——许可文本只是模板、具体条款须逐个查看项目文件，逐字命中。

title: 共同上游作为法律起点
issue: 手册：FreeBSD 1.0“based on the 4.3BSD-Lite (“Net/2”) tape from U.C. Berkeley”，Novell 与 UCB 和解后“the 4.4BSD-Lite release…would be declared unencumbered and all existing Net/2 users would be strongly encouraged to switch. This included FreeBSD”；NetBSD history：“took its roots from the original UCB 4.3BSD via the Net/2 release and 386BSD”；OpenBSD 自述“a FREE, multi-platform 4.4BSD-based UNIX-like operating system”；DragonFly history 载 FreeBSD 4.8 起点——同一清源上游兼法律起点成立。

title: 许可证共同体的单向通量
issue: FreeBSD 目标自述：“to provide software that may be used for any purpose and without strings attached”；about 页：“the Berkeley open source license lets them decide how many of their local changes they want to contribute back”；OpenBSD goals：“encourage companies to use whichever pieces they want to”——条款允许取用而不设回馈义务，商用单向取用为许可内常态。

title: 家族相似的体例与工具
issue: 比较综合题：命题为跨支体例归纳（手册体例、用户空间工具与发行习惯共享），无单一外部断言可定案；离线与目录结构核查相合，共享清源祖承已由四支官方页互证（回指 3.6.1 已证 URL），所列页面仅作旁证。

title: 四分支的身份分工
issue: 四支官方自述血统：FreeBSD“derived from BSD, the version of UNIX developed at the University of California, Berkeley”；NetBSD“an obvious recognition of our heritage as a derivative of 4.4BSD and 386BSD”；OpenBSD“4.4BSD-based”；DragonFly“shares ancestor code with other BSD operating systems”——身份自述齐备；功能分工（规模、广度、安全、实验）如题注自明由史料另行支撑。

title: 差异共同体的自我表述
issue: DragonFly 主页：“DragonFly provides an opportunity for the BSD base to grow in an entirely different direction from the one taken in the FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD series.”；history 页：“originally billed as “the logical continuation of the FreeBSD 4.x series”…but this description has long since become obsolete”——分叉者以另途成长自述，差异成为正当性来源。

title: 服务器定位的技术支撑
issue: about 页：“FreeBSD makes an ideal Internet or Intranet server. It provides robust network services under the heaviest loads and uses memory efficiently to maintain good response times for thousands of simultaneous user processes.”——重负载下的网络服务与内存效率，逐字命中。

title: 37000 个第三方应用的规模
issue: about 页：“With over 37000 ported libraries and applications, FreeBSD supports applications for desktop, server, appliance, and embedded environments.”——三万七千为现行官方口径。

title: 嵌入式平台的延伸
issue: about 页：“From mail and web appliances to routers, time servers, and wireless access points, vendors around the world rely on FreeBSD's integrated build and cross-build environments and advanced features as the foundation for their embedded products.”——路由、时间服务器、无线接入点逐字命中。

title: 基金会作为法律实体
issue: 基金会页：“We also serve as the Project's recognized legal entity, managing contracts, licenses, and other agreements on its behalf.”——代项目管理合同与许可、法人对接能力逐字命中。

title: 云场景中的机队部署
issue: FreeBSD 官方论文页（BSDCan 2019，Looney）：“The content caches run a lightly customized version of the FreeBSD operating system's head branch”“closely tracks the FreeBSD “head” branch (their development branch)…The FreeBSD development branch is usually quite stable”；基金会案例研究：“run a lightly customized version of FreeBSD head, or development, branch”“Running FreeBSD head lets us deliver large amounts of data to our users very efficiently, while maintaining a high velocity of feature development.”——内容分发机队以开发分支为基线、理由为稳定与特性速度之平衡，双一手源。

title: 移植清单的覆盖广度
issue: about 页：“ARM hardware support for a wide range of open, low-cost, and high-end devices, including powerful SBBA/SBBR servers, open hardware laptops, and pocket-sized development boards.”——开放、低成本、高端三类覆盖为官方原文。

title: pkgsrc 的跨平台复用
issue: pkgsrc.org：“pkgsrc is a framework for managing third-party software on UNIX-like systems…It is the default package manager of NetBSD and SmartOS”“Code exists in pkgsrc to support 20+ Unix-like operating systems and 15+ CPU architectures.”——面向类 UNIX 系统而非单一平台，官方原文。

title: 整批设备的接入方式
issue: about 页：“Entirely in the mainline kernel, supported by a single image, and maintained by NetBSD developers with long-term support in mind.”；evbarm 页：“the single GENERIC/GENERIC64 kernel now supports a range of machines”“We provide ready-to-install / boot images for many of the supported boards.”——镜像与内核主线统一、整批设备经同一份发行物接入。

title: 向后兼容的长期守持
issue: about 页：“There's long-term backwards compatibility to even the earliest NetBSD releases without compromising on feature like 64-bit time. We intend to keep these systems running long after Year 2038.”——对最早版本二进制接口的长期兼容列为官方承诺，逐字命中。

title: 互联网协作的组织遗产
issue: about 页：“NetBSD was one of the first major open source projects to be organized collaboratively entirely over the internet, using a network-connected version control system to develop the OS and organizing the project over email since 1993.”——1993 年起完全依托互联网与邮件组织，逐字命中。

title: OpenSSH 的跨系统移植
issue: openssh.com：“OpenSSH is developed by a few developers of the OpenBSD Project and made available under a BSD-style license”“OpenSSH is incorporated into many commercial products”——少数开发者维护、BSD 式许可、广泛并入再分发，官方原文。

title: LibreSSL 分叉的动因
issue: LibreSSL 官方页：“LibreSSL is a version of the TLS/crypto stack forked from OpenSSL in 2014, with goals of modernizing the codebase, improving security, and applying best practice development processes.”——分叉来源与三大目标逐字命中。

title: 审计结论的公开惯例
issue: security 页：“Statements like This problem was fixed in OpenBSD about 6 months ago have become commonplace in security forums like BUGTRAQ.”——修正在先之做法被外部论坛反复引用，官方自述。

title: 安全声誉的外部评价
issue: security 页载外部安全公司检验：“Some members of our security auditing team worked for Secure Networks, the company that made the industry's premier network security scanning software package Ballista…OpenBSD passed Ballista's tests with flying colours since day 1.”——外部专业评价与项目自述互为参照。

title: 许可筛选的准入规则
issue: goals 页：“Integrate good code from any source with acceptable licenses. ISC or Berkeley style licences are preferred, the GPL is not acceptable when adding new code, NDAs are never acceptable.”——GPL 与保密协议明文排除，逐字命中。

title: SMP 锁重写的工程规模
issue: 主页：“Much of the work done since the project began has been in this area…the rewriting of nearly all the original codebase using algorithms designed specifically with SMP in mind”；history 页：“the DragonFly project focused on rewriting most of the major kernel subsystems”——投入最大方向与子系统近整体重写有据。

title: HAMMER2 的替代路线
issue: 主页：“The most prominent one is HAMMER2, our modern high performance filesystem with instant (and mount-writable) snapshots, compression, and de-duplication.”——快照、压缩、去重为官方列举核心特性。

title: swapcache 的存储取舍
issue: 主页：“by making use of swap space to cache filesystem data and meta-data. This feature, commonly referred to as “swapcache”…with a very minor hardware investment.”（承前文 “affordable Solid Storage Devices (SSDs)”）；features 页：“The swapcache(8) feature allows SSD-configured swap to also be used to cache clean filesystem data and meta-data.”——以交换空间缓存文件数据、低价固态盘换读写性能。

title: 性能取向的竞争参照
issue: history 页：“From a performance perspective DragonFly's only real competitor these days is Linux.”——自述性能上唯一真正对手为 Linux，逐字命中。

title: 与 FreeBSD 路线的分野
issue: history 页：“This original design direction, although no longer the primary goal of the DragonFly project, has influenced many of the design decisions made in the intervening years. While full cache coherency is no longer a top level goal, filesystem coherency is”；主页以“an entirely different direction from the one taken in the FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD series”自述分野——最初聚类目标退场而设计取向延续。

title: bmake 自 NetBSD 的引入
issue: FreeBSD 10.0R 发行注：“make(1) has been replaced with the “Portable” BSD make tool (bmake) from NetBSD. (r250699)”——构建工具取自 NetBSD 项目、替换载于发行说明，逐字命中。

title: DRM 与 HDA 的双向移植
issue: history 页：“In 2012 François Tigeot and a dedicated group of helpers began retooling DRM (the graphics subsystem) with an active port from Linux…there was also a concerted effort to upgrade the sound system with a major HDA port from FreeBSD.”——图形自 Linux、音频自 FreeBSD，流向各异，逐字命中。

title: pkgsrc 跨阵营的复用
issue: about 页：“pkgsrc has been widely adopted in the high-performance scientific computing community, including at NASA, and supports other platforms, but NetBSD is prioritized.”——进入科学计算机构（NASA）、取用者超出 BSD 阵营，逐字命中。

title: 条款不设回馈义务
issue: 2-clause 许可正文仅以保留版权与免责声明为条件（“Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted provided that…”），无任何回馈条款；FreeBSD 目标自述“software that may be used for any purpose and without strings attached”——回馈为自愿而非义务。

title: 跨支移植的记名做法
issue: 项目史页逐条记名：DRM“an active port from Linux”、HDA“a major HDA port from FreeBSD”、pkgsrc“the adoption of the pkgsrc framework”；features 页 tmpfs“Originally a NetBSD port the guts have been radically adjusted”——移植注明来源分支，技术流向可在项目史页逐条核对。

title: 竞争作为传播的加速器
issue: 比较史综合题（竞争加速最佳实践扩散），无单一外部事实断言；所涉扩散实例已由本会话取证支撑——OpenSSH 出自 OpenBSD 且被广泛并入（回指 4.3.1）、bmake 自 NetBSD 入 FreeBSD 10（回指 4.5.1）、DRM／HDA 跨支移植（回指 4.5.2），所列页面仅作旁证。

title: 重复劳动的结构代价
issue: 四支各有打包体系：FreeBSD“over 37000 ported libraries and applications”（about）；pkgsrc“over 26,000 packages”（pkgsrc.org）；OpenBSD“it is ported to OpenBSD and packaged”（faq15）；DragonFly“leverages the dports system to provide thousands of applications”（主页）——同一批应用四套打包的结构代价有据。

title: 回流三通道的构成
issue: 比较史框架题（共同上游、直接移植、人员携带三通道），属分析模型而非单一可证事实；其中共同上游与直接移植两通道已由官方页证实（回指 3.6.1 与 4.5.2 已证 URL），人员携带通道待正文另证。

title: 取用多于回馈的常态
issue: FreeBSD about：“the Berkeley open source license lets them decide how many of their local changes they want to contribute back”；OpenBSD goals：“encourage companies to use whichever pieces they want to”——单向取用为许可框架下的常态结果，非失序。

title: 家族自觉的对外整合
issue: 四支皆以 BSD 血统自我定位（回指 3.6.4 已证四页引文）；DragonFly 以“shares ancestor code with other BSD operating systems”与“an entirely different direction”并置家族与分途——家族身份构成对外整合表述。

title: OpenZFS 的跨平台拼合
issue: 官方主页逐字 “The OpenZFS project brings together developers from the Linux, FreeBSD, illumos, MacOS, and Windows platforms”——恰为五个平台并入同一上游。

title: LLVM 重许可的法律基础
issue: LLVM 基金会页载明许可证全名 “Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exception”，并逐字 “The new license was added and changes to the developer policy were completed on January 19, 2019 after the LLVM 8.0 release was branched”——更名与例外条款获一手。

title: Clang 成为默认的节点
issue: 完成点逐字见 FreeBSD 13.0-RELEASE 公告（2021-04-13）“Removed the obsolete binutils 2.17 and gcc(1) 4.2.1 from the tree. All supported architectures now use the LLVM/clang toolchain.”；10.0 发行说明明载当时仅 i386/amd64/arm 等为 clang 默认、其余仍用 GCC 4.2.1——写作时勿把完成点置于 10.0。

title: 重许可的专利保护条款
issue: Apache 2.0 第 3 条逐字 “each Contributor hereby grants to You a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable (except as stated in this section) patent license”；LLVM 基金会另列重许可目标 “Protect users of LLVM code by providing explicit patent protection in the license”。

title: 工具链替换的连带清理
issue: 10.0 发行说明逐字 “GNU patch has been removed from the base system, and replaced by a BSD-licensed patch(1) program”（sort、ar/ranlib、bc/dc、cpio 同批替换为 BSD 许可版）；13.0 公告逐字 “The BSD version of grep(1) is now installed by default. The obsolete GNU version that was the previous default has been removed”。

title: 许可改造的多年进程
issue: LLVM 基金会页逐字 “This project involves sensitive legal issues and has been a multi-year effort”，公开草案时间线自 2015-10 至 2017-08，2019-01-19 新许可落地。

title: GPL 组件的退出路径
issue: 替换实践可证：10.0 发行说明载 GNU patch/sort/ar/ranlib/bc/dc/cpio 均由 BSD 许可版本替换；13.0 公告载 GNU grep 移除、gcc(1) 4.2.1 自树移除——“条件允许时改用更宽松许可版本”逐字成立。

title: 共同上游的再次重建
issue: 官方主页逐字 “OpenZFS is an open-source storage platform”“The OpenZFS project brings together developers from the Linux, FreeBSD, illumos, MacOS, and Windows platforms”——同一上游支撑多操作系统实现。

title: 工程需求驱动的取用
issue: 无特指事实断言的方法论概括（取用理由的定性）；同章 Netflix 个案有 “FreeBSD was selected for its balance of stability and features” 可作正文实例，但非题内断言。

title: 许可兼容性的可测条件
issue: LLVM 基金会时间线逐字 “September 12, 2016: Second license draft, resolving GPL2 compatibility concerns”——例外条款被明确用于解决兼容问题；后半句‘兼容性成为可选工程条件’为方法论引申。

title: Netflix 机队的 FreeBSD 基线
issue: Netflix Open Connect 官方页逐字 “Operating System: FreeBSD -CURRENT (HEAD)”，并载 “All code improvements, feature additions, and bug fixes are contributed directly back to the open source community via the FreeBSD committers on our team”。

title: 视频分发的吞吐需求
issue: 同页设计目标逐字 “Ability to efficiently read from disk and write to network sockets”，与高效读盘、写网络套接字逐字对应。

title: 商业内嵌的选择性吸收
issue: BSD 两句版条款只要求保留版权声明，无回馈义务；Netflix 同页载 OCA 软件 “includes the FreeBSD operating system and the NGINX web server, licensed by BSD” 且其自身全部回馈——‘自定回馈比例’由条款与两端商业实践对照可证。

title: 基金会资助的公共品供给
issue: 基金会页逐字 “The FreeBSD Foundation is a US-based 501(c)(3) non-profit organization”“Funded by individual and corporate donations, we invest directly in FreeBSD through software development, infrastructure improvements, advocacy”。

title: 基础设施化的可见度落差
issue: 解释性论断（关键设施少为人知、可见度与重要性不相称），无特指可核事实；宜作叙事框架而非事实题。

title: Linux 兼容层的功能缺口
issue: Handbook 第 12 章逐字 “FreeBSD provides optional binary compatibility with Linux®, commonly referred to as Linuxulator, allowing users to install and run unmodified Linux binaries”“By default, linux(4) binary compatibility is not enabled”——可选组件＋运行未改动二进制逐字成立。

title: cgroups 与命名空间的缺席
issue: 同章逐字 “Some Linux-specific operating system features are not yet supported; this mostly happens with functionality specific to hardware or related to system management, such as cgroups or namespaces”——系统管理类特性（cgroups、namespaces）缺席与题面几乎逐字对应。

title: 打包体系的各自为政
issue: 四支各有打包体系可证：FreeBSD “pkg(7) is now the default package management utility”（10.0 发行说明）；OpenBSD ports/packages（FAQ 15 “it is ported to OpenBSD and packaged”，pkg_add 体系）；NetBSD pkgsrc（ports/riscv “pre-built binary packages from pkgsrc”）；DragonFly dports（下载页 “install it from dports”）。

title: 许可偏好的内部分歧
issue: OpenBSD 许可政策页逐字 “no additional software bound by the GPL terms will be considered for inclusion into the OpenBSD base system”，且 ISC 为新代码首选许可；对照 FreeBSD 至 13.0 才自树移除 GCC——同族内许可准入分歧有据；‘分裂源于准入规则而非技术’为引申。

title: 统一性测度的分项化
issue: 方法论题（统一性无法整体度量、只能分项取数），无外部事实断言。

title: Par Lab 的 BSD 许可选择
issue: RISC-V 官方史页逐字 “All the projects in the Par Lab were open source using the Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) license, including RISC-V and Chisel.”

title: RISC-V 的 2010 年起点
issue: 同页逐字 “Prof. Krste Asanović and graduate students Yunsup Lee and Andrew Waterman started the RISC-V instruction set in May 2010 as part of the Parallel Computing Laboratory (Par Lab) at UC Berkeley, of which Prof. David Patterson was Director.”——2010 年 5 月、Par Lab、并行计算起因逐字成立。

title: 指令集规范的公有领域处置
issue: 官方史页逐字 “The ISA specification itself (i.e., the encoding of the instruction set) was effectively put into the public domain when the ISA tech reports were published, though the actual tech report text (an expression of the specification) was later put under a Creative Commons license”——公有领域限编码层面，规范文本本体为 CC-BY；技术报告编号 UCB/EECS-2011-62（2011-05-13）已核。写作时宜保持此精确度。

title: 无专利申报的开放前提
issue: 官方史页逐字 “No patents were filed related to RISC-V in any of these projects, as the RISC-V ISA itself does not represent any new technology.”——“项目未就指令集申请专利”逐字成立；规格文本另有不保证免于第三方专利的表述，题面未涉。

title: 开放硬件与开源软件的分界
issue: FAQ 逐字 “Designers are free to develop proprietary or open source implementations for commercial or other exploitations as they see fit.” 及 “No, the source code can be completely closed.”；史页亦载 “anyone may leverage RISC-V as a building block in their open or proprietary solutions and services”——标准开放不等于实现开放有官方明文。

title: FreeBSD 架构清单对 RISC-V 的收录
issue: FreeBSD 平台页受支持清单表格逐字 “64-bit RISC-V | riscv64 | Tier 2”，与 “64-bit ARMv8 | aarch64” 及 powerpc 各系并列。

title: NetBSD 移植的层级定位
issue: ports 页逐字 “NetBSD calls a supported architecture a port.”“Ports are classified into three tiers”“The tier for each port may change over time and is decided by <core@NetBSD.org>.”——以 port 登记并标注层级成立；注意 riscv 有专属 port 页（release info 至 11.0）但未入主页三档表，写作时宜注明。

title: OpenBSD riscv64 板卡的覆盖
issue: riscv64 页逐字列板卡：Allwinner D1（Mango Pi MQ-Pro、Nezha）、SiFive HiFive Unmatched、StarFive VisionFive 与 VisionFive 2、Microsemi PolarFire SoC Icicle Kit（“support is incomplete”），并载 “The current target platform is the HiFive Unmatched board.”——支持范围由硬件清单逐型号界定。

title: DragonFly 的单平台发行
issue: DragonFly 下载页逐字 “DragonFly BSD is 64-bit only.”，发行镜像名为 dfly-x86_64-6.4.2_REL.iso——平台单一、RISC-V 无从进入清单。

title: 支持深度的可比口径
issue: 比较方法论题（以目标平台与层级两项取数作横向对照），无外部事实断言。

title: 板卡清单作为移植证据
issue: OpenBSD riscv64 页逐字 “write an install/miniroot image to a USB flash drive...Make sure you also have the microSD card plugged in that shipped with the HiFive Unmatched board”；NetBSD riscv 页逐字 “Most RISC-V boards require a board-specific U-Boot image.”——“多数板卡须专用引导镜像”逐字成立。

title: 固件与引导的适配门槛
issue: riscv64 页 StarFive 条目逐字 “Note: Some firmware configuration tweaks are necessary to boot OpenBSD”——适配成本落在固件层。

title: 开放硬件的授权状态
issue: 史页逐字 “RISC-V combines a modular technical approach with an open, royalty-free ISA” 且社区可提供 “free or proprietary IP, implementations, solutions, and services”；FAQ 逐字 “There is no fee to use the RISC-V ISA.”、实现 “the source code can be completely closed”——免版税授权与实现各自闭源成立；‘硬件实现仍可各自申请专利’未见一手逐字明文，以专有 IP 条款间接支撑，严格口径可改题侧重免版税与专有实现并存。

title: 移植深度的分层记录
issue: NetBSD ports 页逐字 “Tier I: Focus — support is part of NetBSD's strategy”“Tier II: Organic — evolving at its own pace”“Tier III: Life Support — severely incapacitated or broken”——层级标注即公开记录，便于逐平台核对。

title: 开发板型号的整批登记
issue: OpenBSD 页列 Allwinner/Mango Pi/Nezha/SiFive/StarFive/Microsemi 板卡逐型号；NetBSD riscv 页列 MangoPi MQ Pro、BeagleBoard BeagleV、StarFive VisionFive 2、Milk-V Mars CM——多家厂商开发板整批登记。

title: 免版税标准的聚合效力
issue: 史页逐字 “RISC-V combines a modular technical approach with an open, royalty-free ISA”——免版税与模块化使协作可能。

title: 标准组织与实现的职责切分
issue: FAQ 逐字 “RISC-V International is a nonprofit organization that is the caretaker of the RISC-V instruction set. RISC-V International does not support open source hardware projects.”；史页逐字 “RISC-V International does not manage or make available any open RISC-V implementations, only the standard specifications.”

title: 专有核实现的反例
issue: FAQ 逐字 “Designers are free to develop proprietary or open source implementations”“No, the source code can be completely closed.”——专有实现与开放标准并存有官方明文，构成聚合叙事反例。

title: 许可承诺的永久性
issue: 史页逐字 “The RISC-V ISA and ratified extensions are provided under globally accepted open licenses that are permanently open and remain available for all.”——许可承诺的永久性逐字成立。

title: 聚合节点的成立门槛
issue: 解释性论断（门槛在数十年架构共识而非新颖性），无特指事实。

title: 三段分期的结构划分
issue: 卷内分期框架题（起源、CSRG、分立三段为本书结构安排），无外部事实断言。

title: 循环模型的解释限度
issue: 自反性方法论题（循环模型系分析命名、非当事人自述、不主张历史必然），按卷首声明口径处理。

title: 解散之后的权威分散
issue: ‘多组并行被当事人视为优点’需当事人自述一手：本会话已查各项目官方页、FreeBSD 家族树文件、RISC-V/LLVM/Netflix 官方文本，均未见此自述逐字来源（urls 列为已查的代表页）；tuhs.org 邮件档 403 阻断，McKusick 访谈类一手未及专查（时间盒收口）。建议正文落此论断时补当事人一手引文或降格为结构判断。

title: 分裂次序的家族树记录
issue: FreeBSD src 家族树文件 Dates and Sources 逐字 “NetBSD 0.8 1993-04-20”“FreeBSD 1.0 1993-11-01”“OpenBSD 2.0 1996-10-18”“DragonFly 1.0 2004-07-12”——四次分裂按时序排定、可核。

title: 无回馈义务的长期效应
issue: BSD 两句版条款逐字仅要求 “Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright notice...”，无回馈义务——机制逐字成立；‘商业扩散与公共积累不同步’为方法论引申。

title: 卷末收束与后续卷的交接
issue: 卷末交接与分工注题（outline 注文载模型细解＝第七十四卷第 1 章），离线核对，无外部事实断言。

title: 许可条款中的自由定义
issue: BSD 两句版逐字 “Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted”；OpenBSD 政策页逐字 “The original Berkeley copyright poses no restrictions on private or commercial use of the software”——无差别取用权成立。

title: 源代码作为言论的司法确认
issue: Junger v. Daley（第六巡回，2000-04-04 判决，209 F.3d 481）判词逐字 “Because computer source code is an expressive means for the exchange of information and ideas about computer programming, we hold that it is protected by the First Amendment.”——源码受第一修正案保护成立；‘首次’按首个仍然有效的上诉法院定谳理解（第九巡回 Bernstein 1999 意见撤回一节本会话未单独取证）。

title: 加密出口管制的松绑
issue: 65 FR 2492（2000-01-14 过渡规则，FR Doc 00-983）逐字 “unrestricted encryption source code...can, without review, be released from ‘EI’ controls and exported and reexported under License Exception TSU”，仅须出口时向 BXA 提供网址或副本，并载 “Posting of the source code on the Internet...would not establish ‘knowledge’...of a prohibited export”——‘不再受事前审批约束’逐字成立（松绑口径＝1999-09-16 白宫新政后的本规则）。

title: 任意用途许可的表述
issue: BSD 两句版条款文本只写 “Redistribution and use...are permitted” 加保留声明两项条件，并无‘任何目的’（for any purpose）字样；该措辞见 ISC 许可与 OpenBSD 政策页（“freely used, copied, modified, and distributed by anyone and for any purpose...This maintains the spirit of the original Berkeley Software Distribution”），系对 BSD 精神的概括而非条款原文——‘条款把可用范围写成任何目的’与一手不符。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕

title: 自由叙事的两种落点
issue: 双支点并置为叙事结构题（许可自由与言论自由两条判例线），无特指外部事实断言。
